brewing.notes: A common starting point for herbal infusions: boiling water, about five minutes.

description:
A Brazilian medicinal tea made from Mikania glomerata. Guaco is also a loose name for several climbing plants of Central and South America and the West Indies.

Brew it as you would other herbal infusions. If the plant is new to you, check that it is safe for you first, especially when pregnant or on medication.
history: In Brazil it is commonly drunk as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory, with the effect credited to its coumarin. An old legend holds that the plant's power against snakebite was learned by watching a kite eat its leaves before attacking snakes. Nothing further about the tea's own history is recorded.
